project_title: Modulate Velma-2 STT - Audio Analytics & Transcription Studio

theme_strategy.concept: Dark Tactical Acoustic Workbench (Deep Slate/Charcoal background with Cyan/Indigo acoustic accents, subtle grid lines, high contrast typography, and vibrant emotion/speaker pill badges).

layout_and_grid.header: Glassmorphic navbar with backdrop-blur-md, Modulate Velma-2 badge, active audio waveform indicator, history toggle, and theme switch.
layout_and_grid.main_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6
layout_and_grid.grid_structure: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for Dashboard Workbench - Left/Main side (8 cols) for Dropzone / Player / Interactive Transcript, Right side (4 cols) for Modulate Velma-2 Parameters & Intelligence Toggles.
layout_and_grid.history_view: Full-width analytical table with filters, search, quick replay player, and multi-format download buttons.

key_components.name: HeaderNav
key_components.description: Top fixed navbar with Modulate Velma-2 AI logo, status indicator, history modal/tab button, light/dark mode switch.

key_components.name: FileUploadZone
key_components.description: Interactive drag-and-drop zone with audio/video waveform visualizer, progress bar, sample audio selector buttons (ru samples), and file specs.

key_components.name: ModulateParamSwitches
key_components.description: Card component containing switches for: Speaker Diarization (Диаризация спикеров), Emotion Signal (Сигнал эмоций), Accent Detection (Определение акцента), Deepfake Detection (Детекция дипфейков), PII/PHI Redaction Tags (Теги PII/PHI).

key_components.name: AudioWaveformPlayer
key_components.description: Integrated HTML5 Audio/Video player synced with transcript segment timestamps, with play/pause, seek slider, speed control (0.75x to 2x), and current time display.

key_components.name: TranscriptWorkbench
key_components.description: Dual view container: Full text view + Segmented timeline view with timestamp badges, speaker pills, emotion tags, search/filter bar, and line click-to-seek playback.

key_components.name: DownloadActions
key_components.description: Export action buttons for TXT (Сплошной текст), SRT (Субтитры с таймкодами), JSON (Полная структура Modulate API).

key_components.name: HistoryDrawer
key_components.description: Modal or panel listing previous transcriptions stored in LocalStorage/Backend API with search, audio re-playback, and instant download.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Use Russian text in all UI headers, switches, buttons, and notifications.
2. Ensure header has dark semi-transparent glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl (never fully transparent).
3. Build interactive switches for all Modulate Velma-2 options with informative tooltips in Russian.
4. Implement real file drag-and-drop + file validation (audio/wav, audio/mp3, audio/m4a, video/mp4, video/webm).
5. Provide pre-loaded Russian audio samples for immediate zero-friction testing.
6. Include synchronized audio playback where clicking a transcript segment jumps audio current time to that segment's timestamp.

7. Format downloads cleanly: TXT with clean paragraph text, SRT with standard sequence index, timecodes (00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:02,500), and speaker name, JSON with full Modulate Velma-2 payload structure.
8. Persist history to localStorage or backend database so past transcriptions can be retrieved and re-exported.
9. Add data-testid to every interactive component for automated testing compliance.
